questions.question: What is homogenization of milk? Explain the process and give two advantages.
questions.solution_html:
• What is homogenization of milk? Explain the process and give two advantages. /
  • Homogenization of milk: It is the process of breaking down large fat globules in milk into
  • smaller, uniformly distributed particles to prevent cream separation.
  • Process & advantages: Milk is forced under high pressure through narrow openings to
  • reduce fat globule size; this improves digestibility and gives milk a smooth, uniform
  • texture.
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
questions.final_answer: texture.

questions.solution_html:

  • factors affecting foam stability. /

  • stage due to protein denaturation and air incorporation. (2 marks) .
  • Foam stability is affected by factors like presence of fat (reduces stability) and addition of sugar or
  • acid (improves stability). (2 marks) .
